QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_19

question.text: Indian AIFs are increasingly adopting international LP-reporting templates. Which of the following pair correctly maps an industry body to its reporting standard?

answer.text: CFA Institute — GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards)
IPEV — Stewardship Code for listed investments
ILPA — leverage reporting format prescribed by SEBI

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook links the Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) with the CFA Institute and describes GIPS as the performance-reporting practice for investment performance. The workbook separately treats IPEV as valuation guidance, SEBI as the source of leverage reporting requirements, and Form 64C as the Indian income-tax pass-through statement. The Trap: The Stewardship Code is a SEBI/stewardship-framework concept, not an IPEV product. SEBI (not ILPA) prescribes leverage reporting. Form 64C is an Indian Income-Tax Act form, not an EVCA template. Note: Source pages 170-171, 385, 435 and 466 support the CFA Institute-GIPS mapping and the IPEV, SEBI leverage and Form 64C distinctions.
